description: Tiffany and Leon share the same London flat on opposite schedules without intending to meet, communicating through Post-it notes until practical necessity, family trouble and romantic baggage turn an efficient arrangement into an increasingly intimate relationship.

s01e01.description: After a painful breakup, journalist Tiffany moves into nurse Leon's flat on a time-share arrangement: she has the bed at night, he uses it by day, and they begin getting to know each other through notes without ever meeting.

s01e02.description: Tiffany returns to dating apps while Leon scrambles to raise money for his imprisoned brother Richie, and their increasingly personal Post-it conversations begin making the unseen flatmate relationship matter more than either expected.

s01e03.description: Tiffany and Leon finally arrange to meet on Valentine's Day, but a damaging article about Richie and a missed rendezvous strain the trust that has grown between them.

s01e04.description: With the flatshare arrangement under pressure, Tiffany reconsiders her attachment to Justin while Leon tries to cut loose, yet both keep circling back to the person they still barely know face to face.

s01e05.description: A meddling patient pushes Tiffany and Leon into an unexpected trip to Brighton, where their connection finally becomes harder to dismiss before sudden news changes the direction of the day.

s01e06.description: Richie's hearing and Tiffany's awards ceremony bring several long-running problems to a head as Leon tries to turn their unusual friendship into a real relationship and Justin refuses to disappear quietly.
